feed.title: Personal Data Breaches in Denmark: progress updates
feed.subtitle: A data-driven book on eight years of personal data breach notifications in Denmark. Follow its progress, read the preface, and find preview chapters and their sources here as they are released.

entry.title: The pre-release edition is available to read
entry.summary: The book's free companion edition has been available to read online since August 2026.

entry.title: The preview site opens
entry.summary: This site now carries the book's contents page, a central list of references, and a place for preview chapters.
